## Triage: first grade · `bug` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · carries #12468's red · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-15T10:55Z

Read fresh. objectstack-ai/objectstack#23638 (`c5dd7fce30`, merged 09:48Z) retired the page kind `jsx` from `@objectstack/spec`. objectui still declares and renders it (sites 1–3 above).
- **#12468 (closed as a duplicate of this card) measured the red it causes:**
  - `Spec Main Shape Gate` is red on `main` (its scheduled run at 09:53Z) and on every PR: two `TS2430` at `packages/types/src/layout.ts:1516`, where `PageNodeSchema` no longer extends the spec's `Page`;
  - the gate is advisory and does not block the queue.

**Grade p1 + `target:v18`:**
- It is a red on `main` that every objectui PR shows.
- It is the consumer follow-up of a spec narrowing, which must land before objectui's first 18 release (version PR #11600): objectui's types must extend spec 18's.
- (objectui#12334, the list such follow-ups were carried on, closed at 01:40Z, so this card is its own line in the triage record.)

**Lane `domain:ui`** (`packages/types`, `packages/components`, `apps/console`).

**Scope, in two halves by installability:**
1. **Now:**
   - the console sample `kind: 'jsx'` → `'html'` (`sdui-jsx-preview.tsx:87`, with its header comment);
   - drop `'jsx'` from `PageNodeSchema.kind` (`layout.ts:1795`) and the `@ts-expect-error` list (`authoring-nodes-11364.test.ts:181`).
   - A narrower `kind` extends both the pinned `18.0.0-next.1` and spec `main`, so this turns the gate green without waiting on a release.
2. **The renderer's `'jsx'` branch** (`page.tsx:682`, and its comment at `:673`–`:675`):
   - drop it only once objectui's `@objectstack/spec` resolves a `next` built from a commit carrying `c5dd7fce30`. Before that, a server on `next.1` can still serve a stored `jsx` page that spec 18's rehydration would have turned into `html`.
   - If that release is not out when the PR is ready, the dev splits this half into its own card with `Restart-when: npm view @objectstack/spec@next version names a release built from objectstack c5dd7fce30 or a descendant`.

**Pins:**
- the gate's shape check compiles on spec `main`;
- the console sample renders as an `html` page;
- (half 2) a `jsx` kind is no longer accepted by the type.

Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` reads no path-derived mandate); contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, owed by Clause-② below
Clause-②: yes — the published `@object-ui/types` `PageNodeSchema.kind` narrows (drops `'jsx'`), levelled `minor` (objectui levels a breaking change `minor`, never `major`)
Responsibility: `objectui's PageNodeSchema type mirror, its console sample and the page renderer, which still name the page kind jsx that spec 18 retired | the spec already refuses jsx at parse and its rehydration seams turn a stored jsx page into html; objectui's types do not follow | every objectui PR and main (Spec Main Shape Gate red, the duplicate objectui#12468), and an author typing kind jsx against objectui's types`
Thread-read: 6190403616
Serial constraints cleared: no in-flight claim or open PR touches these files. objectui#12440 (PR #12473) and objectui#12463 (PR #12479), both this seat's, edit `ListView.tsx`, `ObjectView.tsx`, `ConsoleLayout.tsx` and `data-table.tsx`, which is disjoint. The card's `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23638` line is satisfied: that PR merged 2026-10-15T09:48Z. The pin reading (does the resolved `@objectstack/spec` carry `c5dd7fce30`?) decides half 2, per triage.

## Review: ACCEPT — objectui PR #12485 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-15T12:27Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `4cc23c7`, against triage's scope (`6190403616`) and the claim (`6190903933`), not against the dev's report.

- **Shape:** the PR is a draft against `main`. Its body opens `Fixes #12464`, the only closing keyword, followed by `Clause-②: yes`. The governed sweep reads NOT governed, 9 files.
- **Contract review:** PASS `6192017150` at this head.
- **Half 1, met:**
  - `PageNodeSchema.kind` narrows to `'full' | 'slotted' | 'html' | 'react'`. It still extends the spec `Page` at the pinned `18.0.0-next.1` (a subtype of its five-member enum) and at spec `main`: `Type Check` and `Spec Main Shape Gate` are both green on this head, and the gate is green for the first time since objectstack-ai/objectstack#23638.
  - The console sample authors `kind: 'html'`, and the React Pages guide no longer presents `jsx` as accepted.
  - A new pin refuses `kind: 'jsx'` on the type and in the zod face.
- **The claim's file surface, widened on record:** `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts` was outside the declared surface. It is the zod half of the same narrowing (`kind` is the spec's own enum `.extract`-ed to the four members), and the types type-check (`zod-mirror-parity`, TS2322) is red without it. No in-flight claim or open PR touches the file. The seat adds it to this card's surface here.
- **Runtime reach of the zod refusal:** the only page-parsing consumer of the zod face is the CLI's authoring check (`packages/cli/src/utils/authoring-face.ts`, `objectui validate` / `check`). The render path does not parse pages with it. A stored `jsx` page served by a `next.1` server still renders: the page renderer's `'jsx'` arm is kept, read through a widening annotation (`const kind: string | undefined`, not a cast) that TS2367 forced. There is no behaviour change and no alias.
- **Half 2, deferred as triage prescribed:** the resolved spec is `18.0.0-next.1`, whose kind enum still lists `jsx`. Dropping the renderer arm is filed as objectui#12486 (`pm:on-hold`, with triage's `Restart-when:` line verbatim) and carries the dev's three leftovers.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/types: minor` (a published type narrows; objectui levels breaking changes `minor`), `@object-ui/console: patch`. There is no `@object-ui/components` entry: its change is annotation-only, and the fixed group versions it with `types`.
- **Evidence:** the closure build passes, and type-check exits 0 for types, components, app-shell and console. `packages/types/` gives 10335 tests passed, and the targeted page renderer and console suites give 220 passed. Re-adding `jsx` to the union and the extract list turns the new pin red (TS2344 + TS2578). The battery exits 0.
- **CI at head:** 34 success, 3 skipped, 0 failures (`filter=latest`, 37 runs), all 16 test shards and `Spec Main Shape Gate` included.

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
